The Stillroom — a social network for working professionals

The room where work doesn't follow you. Find your crew nearby. No networking required.

LinkedIn is for your career. The Stillroom is for the rest of your life: a community for working professionals and remote, work-from-home people who want to meet others in their city and make real friends outside work.

What you can do

  • Find working professionals in your city (People nearby) and become friends
  • Join or host small real-life events: coffee, walks, co-working, board games
  • Chat with your city, or one-on-one with friends
  • Ask questions in the forums: switching off after work, layoffs, career changes
  • Clarity: a one-minute exercise to work out what you want in life

Join The Stillroom — it's free
